info.name: Waai Media - Contact Info API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for the Waai Media Contact Info Module API (Laravel 13 backend).

### Overview:
The Contact Info Module manages the official contact channels, physical address, and Google Maps location of Waai Media as a singleton settings record.

### Endpoints:
- `GET /api/v1/contact-info` (Public read-only)
- `GET /api/v1/admin/contact-info` (Admin & Editor read)
- `PUT /api/v1/admin/contact-info` (Admin & Editor atomic singleton creation/update)

### Authentication & Security:
- Admin endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` with Sanctum `access` ability.
- Accessible by `admin` and `editor` roles.
- Remember tokens and disallowed roles are rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden.

### Variables:
- `base_url`: Target host (default: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`).
- `admin_token`: Sanctum access token for admin user.
- `editor_token`: Sanctum access token for editor user.
- `token`: Shared access token.
- `disallowed_role_token`: Token without access ability or with unauthorized role (tests 403).
- `revoked_token`: Expired or invalid token (tests 401).
